name: surajlogistic
description: Surajlogistic: road transport platform. backend/ is the API (Fastify + PostgreSQL), frontend/ is the website and apps (React), shared/ holds the rules both use (pricing, statuses, routes).

scripts.dev: npm run dev:backend & npm run dev:frontend
scripts.build: npm run build -w @suraj/backend && npm run build -w @suraj/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @suraj/shared && npm run typecheck -w @suraj/backend && npm run typecheck -w @suraj/frontend
